event.title: Three Men Convicted for Murdering Australian Brothers and US Friend in Mexico
event.canonical_title: Three Men Convicted for Murdering Australian Brothers and US Friend in Mexico
event.summary: Three men have been found guilty of murdering Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, aged 30 and 33, and their friend Carter Rhoad, 30, during a surfing trip in Mexico in 2024. The killings, which occurred during an apparent botched robbery, shocked both Mexico and the international community. The parents of the victims expressed that no outcome can undo the tragedy of their loss.

timeline.title: Three Men Sentenced to 158 Years for Murdering Surfers in Mexico
timeline.summary: A Mexican judge has sentenced three men to 158 years and nine months in prison each for the murders of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their American friend Carter Rhoad. The trio was killed during a surfing trip in Baja California in 2024, reportedly during an attempted robbery.
key_facts: Three men sentenced to 158 years and nine months each.
Victims were Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and American Carter Rhoad.
Murders occurred during a surfing trip in Baja California in 2024.
